title: Conceptual Integration
definition: The process of integrating new concepts into an existing conceptual network while maintaining coherence and consistency.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Conceptual integration is like adding a new piece to a puzzle while making sure it fits perfectly.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: Conceptual integration involves identifying relationships between new concepts and existing concepts.
difficulty_levels.expert: Conceptual integration is a fundamental aspect of cognitive psychology and learning.

extra_fields.insight: Conceptual integration requires a deep understanding of the nature of concepts and the mechanisms of memory and learning.
